strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Akito's Aestivalis is destroyed
Phew, we made it here safely, somehow.
This place is...
Hey, old man, you'd better start explaining.
Weren't we hired to save the people on Mars?
Yeah, yeah. This doesn't add up.
Even so, this is a perfectly fine evacuation facility.
An evacuation facility, but...
This has been a Nergal facility for decades.
Nergal's? You guys don't miss a trick.
Our company's laboratory is a kind of shelter,
so it offers the best odds of survival...
Even though it's surrounded by Tulips on all sides?
Ugh, I'd really like to get out of here soon...
I-is this really safe? They're right next to us.
There's been no recorded activity for decades.
In other words, after they first fell here,
they haven't done anything.
Hey, hey, if you've got business here, hurry up and finish it.
Very well.
...Then, shall we begin the Scaparelli Project?
Um... excuse me!
...Yes?
Um, I... I'd like to borrow an Aestivalis.
Akito?
What for?
To go see Utopia Colony...
Your hometown...?
There's nothing left there now. It's within the Tulips' territory.
The only intact colony on Mars is the Mars Frontier Base.
The Mars Frontier Base... The former Meganoid base?
We'd have to go a long way east from here to reach that base.
I know. But... I just want to see it!
Akito!?
What the hell!? Tenkawa! What do you think you're doing!?
Utopia Colony... My...!
Akito!
Oh, dear... Well, shall we head into the facility as well?
I mean... it's no good. Feels like nobody's been here for months.
Didn't they just run off ages ago?
And anyway, what were you researching way out in the sticks?
The Nadesico.
Huh?
Would you like to see it? The origin of the Nadesico...
We're in this far already... I'll take a look.
By all means. Right this way.
In a run-down place like this?
They say it was ten years after we settled Mars, so, let's see...
It would be about thirty years ago that this was discovered...
Boson reaction increasing.
...Whaaat!?
These guys... the Jovian Lizards!?
Ahh! Akito! Minato! Back Akito up!
Sorry, once we've landed, it takes a little while to take off.
Aestivalis team! Launch ahead of us!
Yamada, Ryoko, Izumi, Hikaru...
In other words, all our Aestivalis pilots are inside the facility.
Get them back, quick! Akitooo!
I've got no choice...! My energy supply's bad, but... I can't die!
Dammit, I'm out of energy...!
Isn't it ready yeeet!?
It'll take a few more minutes for the phase transition engine to stabilize!
We're back!
My, this has gotten quite serious.
Akito's in trouble!?
...Shouldn't you launch quickly?
You're right!
...Wait, who is this person?
Allow me to explain.
I'm Inez Fressange. After this facility...
Tenkawa looks like he's about to die, though.
Eek! Please launch!
All right! Here I go... Huh, what's that!?
Huh!?
Unidentified flying object approaching. It's on visual.
Well, well, kicking up a fuss in a place like this, are we?
Wh-what's that!? It's huge!
That's... Daitarn 3!? Why is it here!?
I've never heard of it.
Allow me to explain. Daitarn 3...
A super robot that fought in the Meganoid rebellion in the last war.
It stands a full 120 meters tall and weighs 800 tons...
Its body of special Da steel is said to be a byproduct of Meganoid R&D...
Much obliged for the introduction. And you're the Federation...
Or should I say Nergal Heavy Industries' private army?
No, no, we're with the Scaparelli Project...
Well, let's leave it at that for now. You there, can you move?
Huh? Oh, more or less...
Looks like he's on our side... Anyway, Aestivalis team, launch!
Hey, wasn't Daitarn 3...
Yes, after the Meganoid rebellion ended.
At any rate, Yamada, you'll miss your chance to shine.
It's Daigoji! All right, here I go!
(Banjo Haran... and an invincible steel man that was meant to be scrapped...
I wonder just how much he knows...)
Everyone!
Looks like the whole cast is here.
Hey, hey, do the line! For the good of the world and its people!
Oh, am I a celebrity too?
...Daitarn 3 shall crush the Jovian Lizards' ambitions!
If you don't fear the brilliance of this rising sun...
Then come and get me!
Whoo! That's the famous Banjo Haran!
Dancougar and Getter Robo on Earth, and now this! I'm on a roll!
They seem... rather excited.
Hey, hey, what's going on?
Well... it's good for morale, I suppose...
(The Federation's bigwigs I can handle somehow...
But super robots, and Captain Bright Noa from the Federation...
How long can I keep up this act...?)
That was so cool! Right, Yamada? Come on, Akito, you too!
Shouldn't we deal with this situation first!?
...Idiot.
Huh!? Ah! These guys!
At Satsuki Midori 2...
Yeah. They're the little guys who suddenly attacked us!?
Ho ho, a full house of guests, I see.
This is no time to be so laid-back!
Huh!? Whaa!? An enemy attack!? Ruri!
There was nothing on radar.
...They may have approached from underground.
Most likely the Za Boom Army.
Kaboom?
Aliens from another star system that recently appeared on Mars.
They've attacked Earth too... And of all people, it's us this time.
I guess they won't stay quiet with us rampaging on their turf.
...But that's no reason to back down. ...Besides...
...There's no mistaking it...!
The Mars Frontier Base was built on an old Meganoid base.
So either the Za Boom Army seized it, or...
Still, doesn't look like we have time to think about it.
Fair enough. Then let's get going!
Is that all right with you, famous Banjo Haran!?
Sure. There are things I need to confirm, after all.
More enemy signals.
What the hell!? One after another!
This reading...
Ruri?
It's a Meganoid.
Huh!?
I knew it... It's you!
It's huge! What is this robot... no, a giant!?
Th-the chest is huge too...
Naturally... It's over 100 meters tall.
About the same as Daitarn 3.
It's been a while, Banjo Haran. ...Have you been well?
Spare me the words you don't mean, Koros.
So... you're still alive.
Just like your Daitarn 3, Banjo.
So we... were both thinking the same thing.
Hey, what's going on?
Looks like they've got history.
...If I remember right, Daitarn 3 is what smashed the Meganoids.
No wonder they're both on edge...
Koros... Seeing you in good health, he must be too...
See for yourself, Banjo. ...If you can, that is.
Fine. I'll do just that...!
With numbers like that... you're doing well, Banjo.
Have you grown old since I last saw you, Koros?
When I crushed your base, I had only Daitarn.
Now I have all this firepower. How could I possibly lose?
...I see. But I've grown more thoughtful too. ...Like so.
Dammit! From over there!?
...The radar should be set to pick up enemies underground too.
We can hardly draft a proposal assuming absurd robots
that roam freely underground. Still...
It'd be bad if the facility got destroyed now.
Aestivalis team, defend the Nergal facility!
Koros...!
What's wrong, Banjo? Surely you'll allow me this much.
No... I was just wondering why Za Boom Army robots appeared
at your signal.
Who can say, Banjo? Why not ask the Martian wind?
Wh-what's that?
Unidentified... An entirely new faction.
Mind if we cut in?
All right!
Geez, Brother, what do you think we came to Mars for!?
Who are you?
For now, I can only say we're passersby.
Meeting here must be fate. Allow us to lend a hand.
Whoa, whoa, what's this!? We're the ones who'll wrap this up in style!
Gai, knock it off! They seem to be on our side.
I don't know who you are... but if you oppose me, I'll face you.
Then so be it... For justice means always opposing vile evil.
Whoa! A real champion of justice! I'm fired up!
Justice... Who is this guy...?
Impressive, Banjo... And you humans as well.
Koros...! I'll settle this with you once again!
Once again? ...Banjo, nothing was settled back then.
Those words are hardly appropriate.
That confidence... So Don Zauser is also...
...You're free to think what you like, Banjo.
Wait! Koros!
The big lady has left radar range. Incredible speed.
If she's still that lively... was she not even trying?
Why did she attack us...?
I can tell, judging by your connection to her. ...Banjo Haran.
Seems there's a story here.
Don't pry, Jet. ...Neither of us should intrude.
Brother, the remaining enemies.
Right. There may be more hiding besides the ones we can see.
Sorry for the wait! Phase transition engine's good to go!
...Search complete. Looks like we're safe now.
Well, that was a surprise. In any case...
Thank you so much! Banjo Haran, and also... um...
Don't mind us. Let's go, everyone.
Could you at least tell us your name?
...My name is Rom Stol.
(I thought he'd say "I have no name to give!" or something.)
This is my sister, Leina.
Nice to meet you.
I'm Blue Jet. This pointy-headed clown here is Rod Drill.
Who're you calling a clown!? Right, Jim?
Now, now, Drill.
...I am Jim. Triple Jim, Lady Leina's attendant.
Why did you all come to Mars?
I had something to look into.
...Lately, something seems off about the Mars Frontier Base...
That Meganoid... came from the Mars Frontier Base!?
Could be... After all, the Development Base...
Yes, it's where Don Zauser, the Meganoid boss, once had his castle.
Now, now, why not come in for some tea for now?
No, we feel we shouldn't get involved with the people of this
star system... But thank you for the kind thought.
(This... star system?)
Man, so there's power suits like that! Let me try one on!
You mean this Power Riser?
No, no, the one with the pointy head over there.
A power suit? Us?
Sorry, but this is our real flesh and blood.
(Flesh and blood...?)
We'll be going. ...May the Kenrou guide you.
Man, what's with that hero act!? Right, Tenkawa!
Y-yeah...
(...Was there really someone inside...?)
Banjo Haran, you are...
I'd love some tea... but this business means I have to hurry.
I'll have to decline.
(I feared this... The Meganoids are back. Reika's team is in danger...!)
